round_interpretation: Round two increased hypervolume by 4.27%. Combining MOVE and slope-change removal with oil created an eleven-input front (IC 0.188889, NLL -1.798295, Sharpe 1.380586). Removing either FX axis damaged IC in all three seeds. Removing rank or dealer proxy also failed to improve this frontier. In the broad model, dropping the remaining HY z-score or the other credit change separately improved IC/Sharpe but traded density. This final bounded family round tests local/risk pruning and modest macro transfers on the compact oil front, and combined block reductions on the broad front. It does not claim family or global optimality.
default_expected_tradeoff: Report IC, NLL and conventional Sharpe jointly with seed stability and calibration. Frontier expansion, not a hidden weighted score, determines progress; input savings remain descriptive.
default_falsification: Dominated results do not support the proposed conditional simplification. The family round cap ends this search even if further improvements remain plausible, and all score dates remain adaptively reused.
